title: Yoisaki Kanade — We're Forgetting Something〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - School Festival
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We need to start heading over to Class 3-C soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. We'll want good seats for Tsukasa and his class's show, so let's go now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Would that be alright, Kanade, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I was really impressed by what Kusanagi and her class did...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really were able to try on all the costumes and outfits you wanted.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Some people decided to dress as hot dogs and bowling pins while we were there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, those...
I never would've tried them on since they looked totally ludicrous.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But they also had some really photogenic cosplay outfits. Like the twelve-layered kimono you tried on, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really startled me when you first asked if I wanted to try it on, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
At first glance, it looked gorgeous enough to be the real deal.
But it was just designed to look like there were twelve layers, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Exactly!
It's also super easy to change into thanks to the magic of hook-and-loop fasteners♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I knew you'd look amazing in it, Kanade, since you have such long hair. I've gotta give myself a pat on the back for this one!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know it was a cosplay outfit, but it still looked fairly heavy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It was...
Once I had it on, I couldn't really move freely.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel like you were barely able to stay standing. I remember your legs wobbling a bit while we were taking pictures.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If a cosplay outfit is that heavy, then I can't even begin to imagine what people back then had to endure.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That reminds me, didn't Mizuki find a dress for you to wear too, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, the long dress with an Asian feel to it? I was asked to try it on, so I did...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And that wasn't a cosplay outfit.
It was a real-life party gown.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But despite the high-class and grown-up aura it exuded, you totally pulled it off, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, Kusanagi and the others also seemed stunned when they saw you in it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel like they were exaggerating...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, what did you all think of that traditional maid dress I wore? It was cute, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that did look really good on you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But it also feels like cheating, you know?
It sorta didn't feel natural.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So what?
I thought the whole point was to dress up and have fun.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You might've had the most fun out of all of us, Ena. You even had Mizuki take all those pictures of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't get me started.
Taking shots from all those angles wasn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget that we all wore those weird dinosaur costumes afterwards like you asked.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, we all dressed up as T-Rexes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They were relatively easy to put on.
All you had to do was step in, zip up the back and inflate it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But is there a reason you wanted us to wear those, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well... Obviously, because I thought all four of us wearing them would make for a really stunning pic.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Plus, I kinda doubt we'll ever find another chance to do that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Kanade, your T-Rex was shorter than ours for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Weren't we all given adult-sized costumes initially?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... Remember the window in the chest that allowed the wearer to see out of it...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My face could only reach about halfway up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, and it would've been a shame if we couldn't really see her face in the picture.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I figured the children's version would fit better and asked her to try that on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Unfortunately, the hole for that one was too low, so I had to hunch over...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This feels kind of surreal...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I never imagined myself going to a school festival with other people.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves, so it could be fun to do more things like this every now and again...)
